description: The shop floor: a plate roller, a bank of gas bottles chained to the wall, and a bench scarred by ten thousand grinds. Sparks fan across the concrete in bright arcs and die. Whatever a district this hard needs bent, cut, or welded shut, it gets made here.

window.description: A window set too high in the wall to see the ground through, so it offers the sky and nothing else. On a bad day that's more information than you want.
window.name: the high window

name: Weld Enough Alone
